people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Keilah
people.line: A town in the Shephelah of Judah, rescued by David

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: David’s men said to him, “Behold, we are afraid here in Judah. How much more then if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?”
translations.bsb: But David’s men said to him, “Look, we are afraid here in Judah; how much more if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?”
translations.kjv: And David's men said unto him, Behold, we be afraid here in Judah: how much more then if we come to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?
translations.asv: And David's men said unto him, Behold, we are afraid here in Judah: how much more then if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?
